description: Defines the BuzzLikeOnCommentModel class, which represents a data model for liking a comment in the Buzz plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It includes metadata annotations for API schema generation and methods for setting entity data and filters.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentModel
